patches.subject: fix: restore legacy buffer producer ABI
patches.reason:
Stock media blobs reference the pre-rename buffer producer symbol.
Forward to the existing implementation without changing the new API.

patches.subject: build: keep Codec2 vendor providers stock
patches.reason:
RoadSTR packages matching stock V1 Codec2 providers. Avoid duplicate
source vendor variants; retain platform implementations. This shared
module availability change requires review for other device targets.

patches.subject: fix: support 64-bit OMX service and sandbox
patches.reason:
RoadSTR is 64-bit only. Pair the OMX service architecture with arm64
syscalls rather than the inherited arm32 sandbox policy. Other targets
requiring 32-bit OMX must retain their original service configuration.

patches.subject: fix: port optional UDFPS HBM integration
patches.reason:
Validate device overlays and sequence optical illumination through the
optional stable HBM service. Empty configuration retains the default
path. Pair with the Lineage UDFPS interface and RoadSTR panel service.

patches.subject: feat: expose device brightness and refresh hooks
patches.reason:
Keep ambient-lux processing in device code behind an empty-by-default
class hook. Retain applied nits and allow overlays to choose the minimum
refresh default. Preserve Evo default 60 Hz; RoadSTR selects 90 Hz.

patches.reason:
Older Motorola input devices expose a different gesture event ABI.
Keep support behind the legacy_double_tap build flag.

patches.subject: fix: restore MotoActions build dependencies
patches.reason:
MotoActions uses internal platform APIs and queries phone state.
Declare the library and permission required by the existing behavior.

patches.subject: build: declare legacy Motorola HIDL interfaces
patches.reason:
Stock health/storage and TCMD blobs need matching prebuilt HIDL
interface metadata and the Motorola package root.

patches.subject: fix: label stock Motorola vendor services
patches.reason:
Stock battery, panel, touch, wireless and Dolby services need dedicated
SELinux labels and scoped access. RoadSTR removes duplicate local labels.
These rules live in the inherited Motorola policy; review concrete paths
and service availability before reuse on another Motorola device.

patches.subject: fix: allow RoadSTR in Motorola eUICC policy
patches.reason:
The shared Motorola allowlist gates the stock eUICC flow. Add RoadSTR
without changing other entries. This device-specific entry remains here
because the shared package owns its resource; prefer a product overlay
if upstream later provides an equivalent supported override.
